findings.evidence: Etale.lean:87-106 and BaseChange.lean:80-101 match line for line apart from variable names (`x`/`y`, `e`/`hVU`) and the final per-chart lemma. Pullback.lean:162-176 builds the same chart cover with the roles of the charts swapped.

Prove `conductor_of_isPullback` as `eq_comap_of_ideal_eq_map _ g fun U V e ↦ conductor_ideal_of_isPullback H U V e`, and move `singularLocus_eq_comap_of_etale` onto it; `fittingIdeal_pullback` repeats the same chart-cover setup and can also use it.
findings.issue: The `charts` / `choose` / `Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers … fromSpec` / `ext_of_comap_openCover` / `change` / `rw [comap_fromSpec_eq_ofIdealTop, comap_comap_fromSpec_eq_ofIdealTop …]` setup (lines 80–101) nearly duplicates `Scheme.singularLocus_eq_comap_of_etale` (Curves/SingularLocus/Etale.lean:87-106) and copies the same chart-cover setup in `Scheme.Modules.fittingIdeal_pullback` (Modules/FittingIdeal/Pullback.lean:162-176).

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/BaseChange.lean:169 `Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization [IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T S) B] : IsPushout R T A B`; conductor_eq_map has exactly the instances `IsLocalization S A'` and `IsLocalization (algebraMapSubmonoid B S) B'`, plus the scalar towers that the new lemma requires.
findings.fix: Prove `conductor_eq_map` from the new lemma: `haveI := Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization S A' B B'; haveI : Module.Flat A A' := IsLocalization.flat A' S; exact conductor_eq_map_of_flat A A' B'`. The `Module.Finite A (B ⧸ 1)` instance comes from `Module.Finite A B`. Alternatively, keep `conductor_eq_map` only as this one-line specialization.
findings.issue: The new `conductor_eq_map_of_flat` implies the existing `conductor_eq_map` (localization case, lines 124-128), which has a weaker statement (it needs `B` finite rather than `B / A` finite). The PR keeps two separate proofs of the same base-change formula.

summary: The algebraic flat base-change result correctly reuses `cokernel_annihilator_flat_baseChange` and `Algebra.IsPushout.equiv`, but the scheme-level proof copies, a fourth time, chart-cover setup that already appears in two places, and the existing localization lemma `conductor_eq_map` is now a special case of the new theorem and still has its own separate proof.
